verdict.rationale: Docs show rule-based targeting (targeting mobile platforms, internal testers, overrides for specific users, target apps to scope gates) which supports attribute-based rules, but there is no explicit mention of reusable 'segments' as a standalone targeting object that can be shared across multiple flags/experiments. missing for 10: explicit reusable segment/audience feature documentation, examples of attribute-based rule builder UI, and independent confirmation of segment reuse across flags.
